title: Healify
description: A simple mod that adds a simple healing mechanic
body:
Simple Medicine is a small vanilla-friendly mod that adds simple medical items for healing and survival in Minecraft.

The mod is designed to fit naturally into the game without complicated systems or unnecessary mechanics, making it suitable for both regular survival and modpacks.

Current Content
Patch — restores 2 hearts
Bandage — restores 4 hearts
Golden Bandage — restores 6 hearts and grants short protection
Plans

Future updates are planned to expand the mod with more healing and medical-related content.
